title: Mediators-induced restructuring of microbial community in BES
description: This project investigates mediator-associated restructuring of bacterial communities in bioelectrochemical systems (BESs) operated at an applied voltage of 0.6 V. Microbial samples were collected from BESs under three conditions: no added mediator (blank), riboflavin (Rf) addition, and ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid (EDTA) addition. Raw paired-end FASTQ reads were generated by Illumina NovaSeq sequencing of the V3-V4 region of the bacterial 16S rRNA gene. The dataset was generated to compare bacterial community composition among the three treatments and to evaluate microbial community shifts associated with Rf and EDTA addition. For downstream analysis, sequence reads were quality-filtered and denoised using DADA2, followed by taxonomic assignment against the SILVA 138 database.
